bio_en: Petros Melik-Andreasian, later known as Petros Khan, was born in 1879 in Mujumbar, a purely Armenian village near Tabriz, into a family descended from the meliks of Karabakh. Energetic and a born leader, he moved in 1908 to Rasht to work in a silk-cocoon factory; at first drawn to the Hnchaks, he grew dissatisfied with their inaction. When in 1909 Persian and Georgian revolutionaries crossed from Baku to Rasht and raised the constitutional banner, he joined the Gilan revolution and fought in its campaigns alongside Yeprem.
